findings.title: publish_audit release gate can never return NO-GO for a P0
evidence: tools/publish_audit.py:198 'GO' if no P0/P1 else 'GO WITH CONDITIONS'
tools/full_domain.py:438-439 maps any P0 to NO-GO
findings.impact: A focused published run containing a P0 blocker reports a conditional-go verdict, directly contradicting the repository's severity semantics.
findings.recommendation: Share one gate function; add a P0 test asserting NO-GO; regenerate affected archived focused runs.

findings.title: Executive summary lists covered domains but not uncovered/N-A domains
evidence: tools/full_domain.py:445-462 write_exec_summary lists m['scope']['domains'] and high findings only
findings.impact: Readers cannot tell which domains were skipped versus produced no findings.
findings.recommendation: Add a coverage line (emitted/NA/pending) to the summary.

report: Synthesis domain. Verified the gate logic in both aggregate and publish paths.
